title: Shinonome Akito — Towards Legend〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hi, Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Over here!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Be right there.
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're figuring out the set list for our next event, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, let's get that out of the way so we can get to practicing!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You two seem way too excited...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, we've had an interesting couple of days.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So this is where RAD WEEKEND happened...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's so much smaller than I remember.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Probably because we were kids.
I'm guessing we were both a lot shorter back then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. That means we've grown up a lot since.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Still, the stage is literally right in front of us...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's about time you guys saw this.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: It's a video of RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: So, what did you think of RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Think you can surpass it...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't say for sure...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It exceeded all of my expectations...
I sort of can't believe something like this actually happened...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's... Scary...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel more excited about this than before.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel even more determined to surpass RAD WEEKEND now. So...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We will... We absolutely will!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess just that day alone was pretty jam-packed...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only did we get to visit where you and Shiraishi had gone all those years ago, we got to see a video of what happened.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
But it wasn't just us.
Mita, Tono and even his partner...
They were all there too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm pretty sure all the other teams we've been running into were there as well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's on top of our local music lovers!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come to think of it, that was also when I first met that one guy.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (So many people. I can't see the stage at all.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: (Most of these people are probably regulars here, so I won't be able to just push my way through them. I'll just listen here and...)

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Hey, you!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: Huh? A-Are you talking to me...?

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line:
Yeah, you!
Don't be a wallflower! Get in the middle!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: This might be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, kid! We're probably never gonna see a lineup like this again!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: You had the guts to come here, so you should try to get the most out of this chance!

rows.Speaker: Man
rows.Line: Don't worry, we're all here to have fun and see what unfolds!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Akito
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
In that case...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was so nice of him.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he's sort of the reason why I was able to get into music. He showed me how fun it could be.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And he hasn't changed one bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You mean now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You've met him before.
He's the manager where I work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're totally right!
He's like the definition of a music connoisseur!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've even heard that he wanted to open a shop on Vivid Street just so he can go to live houses every day.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does that mean you started working for him because of this encounter you had?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, that was just a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I went around Vivid Street to see if there was anything good since it was close to the park where we practice...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That was when I stumbled upon this boutique shop. It was only when I went in to take a look that I found out he's the manager.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: He vaguely remembered who I was, patted me on the back and said, “Look at you! All grown up!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! He sounds like your uncle, not your manager!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know, right? He was just looking to hire someone, so I decided to work there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Not only that, he didn't laugh at my dream.)

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: You're gonna surpass RAD WEEKEND, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: That's great! I've been waiting for a kid like you to show up!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Wouldn't it be something if you ended up becoming the next RADder, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Oh, don't forget to let me know when you're gonna be in events and stuff! I'll be there rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, enough talk.
Let's get this set list out of the way.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now Akito's all fired up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I can see that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
All good in my book!
Let's hurry up and do this already!
